description: Example of a user-supplied ACE rule set. Import it in Settings > Migration rules. Rules without a 'status' are treated as heuristic.

rules.title: Endpoint uses a hard-coded IP address
rules.why: IP addresses differ between environments and break on re-addressing.
rules.action: Use a host name and set it per environment through BAR overrides.

rules.title: Data source used by flows (inventory)
rules.why: Every DSN needs an ODBC definition and credentials on the ACE 13 server.
rules.action: Add each DSN to the environment build sheet.

rules.title: ESQL calls Java - owner sign-off required
rules.why: Organisation policy: Java called from ESQL must be signed off by the Java code owner after the Java 17 move.
rules.action: Get sign-off from the owning team.
